metadata.scope: Scraping, source lineage, and hash ingestion

findings.title: TLS certificate verification was disabled
findings.control: Use system CA validation; never install an unverified global SSL context.

findings.title: Redirect and response origin were not validated
findings.evidence: Scraper validates HTTPS/exact host before following a redirect and rechecks the final URL
findings.control: Validate requested and final URL against allowlist.

findings.title: SEDGIS layer provenance is partially resolved
findings.evidence: Exact canal item, service, and source URLs plus item timestamps were acquired. The checked-in GeoJSON still lacks a matching upstream export checksum and a formal published license.
findings.control: Re-export each layer with an immutable raw manifest and obtain a formal license statement before production use.

findings.title: Asset owner values remain unresolved
findings.evidence: 247 source records require manual owner review.

findings.title: Source district text conflicts with polygon
Raw source response integrity was not recorded
findings.evidence: New scraper outputs source_response_sha256; existing snapshots predate this control.
findings.control: Retain raw response hash and fetched timestamp.

findings.title: Response size, MIME, and UTF-8 were not strict
findings.evidence: Scraper now limits response bytes and validates content type and strict UTF-8.
findings.control: Fail closed on malformed or oversized responses.

findings.title: Empty history parse could be treated as success
findings.evidence: Zero-series history and mismatched cached station IDs now fail validation.
findings.control: Quarantine parser-empty histories as source errors.

findings.title: Official mission evidence is not legal approval
findings.evidence: Mission/SOP evidence and district processes remain pending legal and district confirmation.
findings.control: Two-person legal review before verified promotion.

findings.title: Integrity manifest is unsigned
findings.control: Sign releases with a managed key or CI attestation.
